attr.title: DDraceNetwork
attr.desc: DDraceNetwork (DDNet) is a free, open source cooperative online platformer based on Teeworlds. Hook, jump and hammer your way through thousands of race maps together with other players, or play offline on a local server.
attr.inst: Ready to play. Online play needs Wi-Fi; offline, use Play > Create Server (local server). Set your name in conf/settings_ddnet.cfg (player_name).
